<h1>一键生成短视频：MoneyPrinterTurbo 开源项目深度解析</h1>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p>一行命令，让 AI 帮你写文案、找素材、配音、剪辑——全自动视频生产流水线，56K+ Star 验证。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">引子</h2>
<p>我的中转站：https://api.aiseo.one/register?channel=c_0qyhisw6</p>
<p>你有没有这样的经历：</p>
<p>想做一个知识类短视频账号，但每次都要——</p>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p>"写脚本、录配音、找素材、剪视频..."</p>
</blockquote>
<p>一个 2 分钟的视频，花了 3 个小时。一个月下来，累得半死，产出还不到 10 条。</p>
<p>试过 AI 视频工具？要么只能生成几张图片轮播，要么配音像机器人，要么素材和文案对不上。想找个真正能用的"全自动"方案，折腾了一圈发现还是要自己动手。</p>
<p><strong>这不是你的问题，而是视频制作的门槛本来就高。</strong> 文案、配音、画面、字幕、剪辑——每个环节都是独立技能。</p>
<p>直到我发现了 <a href="https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo" rel="noopener nofollow">MoneyPrinterTurbo</a>——这个项目把"一句话生成视频"这件事，变成了现实。</p>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">项目简介</h2>
<p><strong>MoneyPrinterTurbo</strong> 是一个开源的 AI 视频生成工具（MIT 协议），作者是 harry0703。它的定位非常清晰：</p>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p><strong>一句话生成视频：输入主题，自动完成文案→配音→素材→字幕→合成。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>一句话概括：<strong>本地运行、免费开源、支持 15+ LLM 提供商、9 种 TTS 方案、三种运行模式（Web UI / API / CLI），从脚本到成片全程自动化。</strong></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">核心特性</h3>
<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 20px 0">
<thead>
<tr><th style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px; background: rgba(240, 240, 240, 1); font-weight: bold">特性</th><th style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px; background: rgba(240, 240, 240, 1); font-weight: bold">说明</th></tr>

</tr>

<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px"><strong>15+ LLM</strong></td>

<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">Web UI（可视化）、API（集成）、CLI（批量）</td>

</tr>

</tr>

<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">技术架构</h2>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">核心理念：视频生产流水线</h3>
<p>MoneyPrinterTurbo 的设计哲学是：<strong>把视频制作拆解成标准化的流水线，每个环节独立可替换。</strong></p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code>┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      用户输入主题                            │
│              "如何用 AI 提高工作效率"                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Step 1: 文案生成 (LLM)                      │
│   OpenAI / Claude / DeepSeek / Ollama / ...                 │
│   输入主题 → 输出结构化脚本（标题 + 分镜文案）                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Step 2: 配音合成 (TTS)                       │
│   Edge-TTS（免费）/ Azure / OpenAI / Fish TTS / ...         │
│   文案 → 音频文件 + 时间轴                                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Step 3: 素材匹配                             │
│   Pexels / Pixabay / 本地素材库                              │
│   分镜关键词 → 视频/图片素材                                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Step 4: 字幕生成                             │
│   自动对齐时间轴 + 样式渲染                                    │
│   输出 SRT 格式 + 内嵌字幕                                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Step 5: 视频合成                             │
│   MoviePy + FFmpeg                                           │
│   素材 + 配音 + 字幕 → 最终视频                                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">项目结构</h3>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code>MoneyPrinterTurbo/
├── app/                    # 主应用
│   ├── controllers/        # API 路由控制器
│   │   └── video.py        # 视频生成 API
│   ├── services/           # 核心业务逻辑
│   │   ├── llm/           # LLM 服务（15+ 提供商）
│   │   ├── tts/           # TTS 服务（9 种方案）
│   │   └── material.py    # 素材匹配服务
│   ├── models/            # 数据模型
│   └── utils/             # 工具函数
├── resource/              # 静态资源
│   ├── fonts/             # 字体文件
│   └── html/              # 模板文件
├── webui/                 # 前端（Streamlit）
│   └── Main.py            # Web UI 入口
├── config.toml            # 配置文件
├── Dockerfile             # Docker 构建
└── docker-compose.yml     # 一键启动
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">架构分层</h3>
<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 20px 0">
<thead>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px"><strong>接入层</strong></td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">用户交互</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">Streamlit Web UI / FastAPI / CLI</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px"><strong>编排层</strong></td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">流程调度</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">主控制器协调各服务</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px"><strong>服务层</strong></td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">核心能力</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">LLM / TTS / 素材 / 字幕</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px"><strong>基础设施</strong></td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">底层依赖</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid rgba(204, 204, 204, 1); padding: 12px">MoviePy / FFmpeg / Redis</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">核心代码解析</h2>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">1. 视频生成流水线</h3>
<p>整个视频生成流程由 <code>VideoService</code> 统一编排：</p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># app/services/video_service.py（简化版逻辑）</span>

<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">VideoService</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">generate_video</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">topic</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">config</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">VideoConfig</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="c1"># Step 1: 生成文案</span>
        <span class="n">script</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">llm_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate_script</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">topic</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">topic</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">style</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">style</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">language</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Step 2: 合成配音</span>
        <span class="n">audio_segments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">scene</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">script</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">scenes</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">audio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tts_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">synthesize</span><span class="p">(</span>
                <span class="n">text</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">scene</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">narration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">voice</span>
            <span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">audio_segments</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Step 3: 匹配素材</span>
        <span class="n">materials</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">material_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">match</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">keywords</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">scene</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">keywords</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">scene</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">script</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">scenes</span><span class="p">],</span>
            <span class="n">source</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">material_source</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Step 4: 生成字幕</span>
        <span class="n">subtitles</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subtitle_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">audio_segments</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">audio_segments</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">style</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subtitle_style</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Step 5: 合成视频</span>
        <span class="n">final_video</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">compose_video</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">materials</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">materials</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">audio</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">audio_segments</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">subtitles</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">subtitles</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">aspect_ratio</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">aspect_ratio</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">final_video</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>精妙之处：</strong><br>
- 每个步骤独立可替换——不满意某个 TTS？换成 Azure 只需改配置<br>
- 异步设计——支持并发处理多个场景<br>
- 配置驱动——所有参数通过 <code>config.toml</code> 控制</p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">2. LLM 服务抽象</h3>
<p>项目支持 15+ LLM 提供商，核心是统一的接口抽象：</p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># app/services/llm/base.py</span>

<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">LLMProvider</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ABC</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="nd">@abstractmethod</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">generate_script</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> 
        <span class="n">topic</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">language</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"zh-CN"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">style</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"professional"</span>
    <span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="n">VideoScript</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="sd">"""生成视频脚本"""</span>
        <span class="k">pass</span>

<span class="c1"># app/services/llm/openai.py</span>
<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">OpenAIProvider</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">LLMProvider</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">generate_script</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">topic</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">**</span><span class="n">kwargs</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="n">VideoScript</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">client</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">chat</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">completions</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">create</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">messages</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
                <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"role"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"system"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"content"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">SCRIPT_SYSTEM_PROMPT</span><span class="p">},</span>
                <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"role"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"user"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"content"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"主题：</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">topic</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">}</span>
            <span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">VideoScript</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_json</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">choices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">message</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">content</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># app/services/llm/ollama.py（本地模型）</span>
<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">OllamaProvider</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">LLMProvider</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">generate_script</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">topic</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">**</span><span class="n">kwargs</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="n">VideoScript</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="c1"># Ollama 本地推理，零成本</span>
        <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">client</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">prompt</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"生成视频脚本：</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">topic</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">VideoScript</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_json</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">response</span><span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>支持的 LLM 提供商：</strong></p>

<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">3. TTS 服务矩阵</h3>
<p>配音是视频的灵魂，项目支持多种 TTS 方案：</p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># app/services/tts/edge_tts.py（免费方案）</span>

<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">EdgeTTSProvider</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">TTSProvider</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">synthesize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="n">AudioSegment</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="c1"># 微软 Edge-TTS，完全免费</span>
        <span class="c1"># 支持中英文，多种音色</span>
        <span class="n">communicate</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">edge_tts</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Communicate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">communicate</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"temp.mp3"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">AudioSegment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_mp3</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"temp.mp3"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># app/services/tts/azure_tts.py（专业方案）</span>
<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">AzureTTSProvider</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">TTSProvider</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">synthesize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="n">AudioSegment</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="c1"># Azure 语音服务，情感丰富</span>
        <span class="c1"># 需要订阅 Key，但效果最好</span>
        <span class="n">speech_config</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">SpeechConfig</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">subscription</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">region</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">region</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">synthesizer</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">SpeechSynthesizer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">speech_config</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">speak_text_async</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">AudioSegment</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">audio_data</span><span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">4. 素材智能匹配</h3>
<p>素材匹配采用关键词搜索 + 智能筛选：</p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># app/services/material.py</span>

<span class="k">class</span><span class="nc">MaterialService</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">keywords</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">List</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"pexels"</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">materials</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">keyword</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">keywords</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="c1"># 从 Pexels/Pixabay 搜索</span>
            <span class="n">results</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">search_media</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">keyword</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># 智能筛选：时长、分辨率、相关性</span>
            <span class="n">best_match</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">select_best</span><span class="p">(</span>
                <span class="n">results</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="n">criteria</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span>
                    <span class="s2">"min_duration"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"min_resolution"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1920</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1080</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"relevance_threshold"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.8</span>
                <span class="p">}</span>
            <span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">materials</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">best_match</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">materials</span>

    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">search_media</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">keyword</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">source</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">"pexels"</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="c1"># Pexels API，免费高清素材</span>
            <span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">httpx</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">AsyncClient</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">client</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">resp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">client</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span>
                    <span class="s2">"https://api.pexels.com/videos/search"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="n">params</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"query"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">keyword</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"per_page"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">},</span>
                    <span class="n">headers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"Authorization"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">api_key</span><span class="p">}</span>
                <span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">resp</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="p">()[</span><span class="s2">"videos"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="c1"># 支持本地素材库</span>
        <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">source</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">"local"</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">local_db</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">search</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">keyword</span><span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">快速开始</h2>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">方式一：Docker 一键启动（推荐）</h3>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># 克隆项目</span>
gitclonehttps://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo.git
<span class="nb">cd</span>MoneyPrinterTurbo

<span class="c1"># 配置环境变量</span>
cpconfig.toml.exampleconfig.toml
<span class="c1"># 编辑 config.toml，填入 API Key（可选）</span>

<span class="c1"># Docker 启动</span>
docker-composeup-d

<span class="c1"># 访问 Web UI</span>
openhttp://localhost:8501
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">方式二：本地安装</h3>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># 克隆项目</span>
gitclonehttps://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo.git
<span class="nb">cd</span>MoneyPrinterTurbo

<span class="c1"># 创建虚拟环境</span>
python-mvenvvenv
<span class="nb">source</span>venv/bin/activate

<span class="c1"># 安装依赖</span>
pipinstall-rrequirements.txt

<span class="c1"># 安装 ImageMagick（视频处理必需）</span>
<span class="c1"># macOS</span>
brewinstallimagemagick
<span class="c1"># Ubuntu</span>
sudoaptinstallimagemagick

<span class="c1"># 启动 Web UI</span>
streamlitrunwebui/Main.py
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">最小配置（免费使用）</h3>
<p>只需修改 <code>config.toml</code>：</p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="k">[app]</span>
<span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN"</span><span class="c1"># 中文</span>

<span class="k">[llm]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"deepseek"</span><span class="c1"># 或 "ollama" 本地运行</span>
<span class="n">deepseek_api_key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"your-key"</span><span class="c1"># DeepSeek 很便宜</span>

<span class="k">[tts]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"edge-tts"</span><span class="c1"># 完全免费</span>

<span class="k">[material]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"pexels"</span><span class="c1"># 免费高清素材</span>
<span class="n">pexels_api_key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"your-key"</span><span class="c1"># 免费申请</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">一键生成视频</h3>
<p><strong>Web UI：</strong></p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="mf">1.</span><span class="n">打开</span><span class="n">http</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">//</span><span class="n">localhost</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="mf">8501</span>
<span class="mf">2.</span><span class="n">输入主题</span><span class="err">：</span><span class="s">"如何提高工作效率的 5 个技巧"</span>
<span class="mf">3.</span><span class="n">选择配音风格</span><span class="err">、</span><span class="n">视频尺寸</span>
<span class="mf">4.</span><span class="n">点击</span><span class="s">"生成视频"</span>
<span class="mf">5.</span><span class="n">等待</span><span class="mf">2</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mf">5</span><span class="n">分钟</span><span class="err">，</span><span class="n">下载成品</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>API 调用：</strong></p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="kn">import</span><span class="nn">requests</span>

<span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">post</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">"http://localhost:8080/api/v1/videos/generate"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s2">"topic"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"AI 将如何改变未来工作"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"language"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"zh-CN"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"voice"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"aspect_ratio"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"9:16"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"duration"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">60</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">video_url</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="p">()[</span><span class="s2">"video_url"</span><span class="p">]</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>CLI 批量：</strong></p>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code>pythonmain.py<span class="se">\</span>
--topic<span class="s2">"如何培养阅读习惯"</span><span class="se">\</span>
--languagezh-CN<span class="se">\</span>
--aspect-ratio<span class="m">9</span>:16<span class="se">\</span>
--output./videos/
</code></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">实战案例</h2>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">案例一：知识类短视频矩阵</h3>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p>目标：每天生产 10 条知识类短视频</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="n">topics</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="s2">"如何提高专注力的 3 个方法"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">"睡眠质量差的真正原因"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">"为什么早起的人更成功"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="c1"># ... 更多主题</span>
<span class="p">]</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">topic</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">topics</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">video_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate_video</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">topic</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">topic</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN-YunyangNeural"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">aspect_ratio</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"9:16"</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># 竖屏适合抖音</span>
        <span class="n">style</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"knowledge"</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>效果：</strong><br>
- 单条视频成本：&lt; ¥0.5（DeepSeek + Edge-TTS + Pexels）<br>
- 日产 10 条，月产 300 条<br>
- 适合知识博主、企业号批量运营</p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">案例二：产品宣传视频</h3>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p>需求：为新产品生成 60 秒宣传视频</p>

</blockquote>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">video_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate_video</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">topic</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"""</span>
<span class="s2">    产品介绍：</span>
<span class="s2">    - 名称：智能水杯 Aqua</span>
<span class="s2">    - 卖点：自动提醒喝水、水温显示、健康追踪</span>
<span class="s2">    - 目标用户：办公室白领</span>
<span class="s2">    风格：简洁现代</span>
<span class="s2">    """</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">aspect_ratio</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"16:9"</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># 横屏适合 B站</span>
    <span class="n">material_source</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"local"</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># 使用产品素材</span>
    <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>优化点：</strong><br>
- 使用 <code>material_source="local"</code> 替换为产品实拍素材<br>
- 调整 <code>style="commercial"</code> 增加营销感</p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">案例三：多语言视频批量生产</h3>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p>需求：同一内容生成中英文双语版本</p>

</blockquote>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="k">async</span> <span class="k">def</span><span class="nf">generate_multilingual</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">topic_zh</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">topic_en</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="c1"># 中文版本</span>
    <span class="n">video_zh</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">video_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate_video</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">topic</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">topic_zh</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"zh-CN-YunyangNeural"</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># 英文版本</span>
    <span class="n">video_en</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">video_service</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">generate_video</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">topic</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">topic_en</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"en-US"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"en-US-JennyNeural"</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">video_zh</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">video_en</span>

<span class="k">await</span> <span class="n">generate_multilingual</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">"AI 如何改变教育行业"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">"How AI is Transforming Education"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<hr>

<p><strong>MoneyPrinterTurbo 的核心优势：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>真正免费</strong> - Edge-TTS + DeepSeek/Ollama 零成本运行</li>
<li><strong>源码可控</strong> - 完全开源，可深度定制</li>
<li><strong>本地运行</strong> - 数据不出本地，隐私安全</li>
<li><strong>模块化设计</strong> - 每个环节独立可替换</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>适合人群：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 内容创作者（知识博主、自媒体运营）</li>
<li>✅ 企业营销团队（批量视频生产）</li>
<li>✅ 开发者（二次开发、API 集成）</li>
<li>✅ AI 爱好者（学习视频生成技术）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>不适合场景：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>❌ 需要真人出镜（这个做不到）</li>
<li>❌ 高端商业广告（素材和配音还不够精致）</li>
<li>❌ 实时直播（这是录播，不是直播）</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">最佳实践</h2>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">1. 国内用户推荐配置</h3>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="k">[llm]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"deepseek"</span><span class="c1"># 国产，便宜，中文好</span>
<span class="n">deepseek_api_key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"sk-xxx"</span>

<span class="k">[tts]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"edge-tts"</span><span class="c1"># 免费，中文效果好</span>

<span class="k">[material]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"pexels"</span>
<span class="n">pexels_api_key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"xxx"</span><span class="c1"># 免费申请</span>

<span class="k">[proxy]</span>
<span class="c1"># 不需要代理，国内直连</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">2. 性能优化建议</h3>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># 并发生成多个视频</span>
uvicornmain:app--workers<span class="m">4</span>

<span class="c1"># 使用 Redis 缓存素材</span>
redis-server<span class="p">&amp;</span>
<span class="c1"># config.toml 添加</span>
<span class="o">[</span>cache<span class="o">]</span>
<span class="nv">provider</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"redis"</span>
<span class="nv">url</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"redis://localhost:6379"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 25px">3. 素材库建设</h3>
<div class="codehilite">
<pre><code><span class="c1"># 定期下载高质量素材到本地</span>
<span class="n">python</span> <span class="n">scripts</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">download_materials</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">py</span> \
    <span class="o">--</span><span class="n">keywords</span> <span class="s2">"办公,科技,城市,自然"</span> \
    <span class="o">--</span><span class="n">output</span> <span class="o">./</span><span class="n">local_materials</span><span class="o">/</span>

<span class="c1"># 配置优先使用本地素材</span>
<span class="p">[</span><span class="n">material</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">provider</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"local"</span>
<span class="n">local_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"./local_materials/"</span>
<span class="n">fallback</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"pexels"</span>  <span class="c1"># 本地没有时回退到 Pexels</span>
</code></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h2 style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 30px">总结</h2>
<p>MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个真正把"AI 视频生成"落地的项目。它没有追求花哨的功能，而是把<strong>生产效率</strong>做到了极致。</p>
<p>它的架构哲学值得称道：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>流水线思维</strong> - 每个环节独立可替换</li>
<li><strong>配置驱动</strong> - 改配置不用改代码</li>
<li><strong>多模式运行</strong> - Web/API/CLI 适应不同场景</li>
<li><strong>成本可控</strong> - 免费方案完全可用，付费方案效果更好</li>
</ul>
<p>如果你是内容创作者，想在 AI 时代提升产能，这个项目值得花时间研究。它不会替代你的创意，但会把繁琐的执行工作全部自动化。</p>
<blockquote style="border-left: 5px solid rgba(0, 120, 215, 1); margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(249, 249, 249, 1); color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-style: italic">
<p>⭐ <strong>项目地址：</strong> https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo<br>
 <strong>安装：</strong> <code>docker-compose up -d</code><br>
 <strong>协议：</strong> MIT（商业可用）</p>

</blockquote>
